blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The prosecution panel in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte has asked the Senate impeachment court to be allowed to present a forensic financial analyst first as their witness instead of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) representative since the assigned prosecutor tasked is indisposed. At the start of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Thursday, public prosecutor and Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon requested that forensic expert Atty. Alex Cabrera be presented first before the BIR since counsel for the prosecution Erwin Matib is sick. Matib is the lawyer assigned by the prosecution panel […]...
